Good to Know

Q & A

How do I RSVP?

Tap RSVP anywhere on this page to open our short form and let us know if you’ll be joining us. Kindly respond by September 20, 2026.

When should I RSVP by?

Please send your response by September 20, 2026 so we can plan for you with care.

Where should I park?

At the Diyanet Center — there is ample free parking in the underground garage beneath the main mosque.
At the dinner — as the event falls on a Sunday, street parking along the roads around the apartment is free. Guest parking is also available in the building’s underground garage; passes are arranged on the day, so kindly reach out to us and we’ll get one sorted for you.

How do I get to the ceremony at the Diyanet Center?

Park in the underground garage beneath the main mosque, then take the stairs up into the main mosque building — the Nikkah will be held in the main hall. Ladies, kindly remember a scarf to cover your head. If you need help on the day, call Ahsan at (828) 781-5040.

How do I get to the dinner once I arrive?

Our dinner is in the club room on the 11th floor of Camden Potomac Yard Apartments. When you arrive, stop by the front desk in the main lobby and let them know you’re here for the wedding dinner in the club room. They’ll give you access to the elevator — take it up to the 11th floor, step out and turn right, and the club room is just down the hall.

What should I wear?

We’d love a soft, coordinated palette — only if it’s easy for you:
Groom’s side — gentlemen in a cream, off-white or white kurta; ladies in baby blue, light pink or light pistachio green.
Bride’s side — ladies in pink; gentlemen in an off-white kameez with a light-coloured waistcoat.
Most of all, please come comfortable.

Do ladies need to cover their heads?

Yes — as the Nikkah takes place in the mosque, head coverings are required for ladies. Kindly bring a scarf or dupatta to cover your head during the ceremony.

Who can I contact with questions?

We’d love to help:
Groom’s side — Ahsan, (828) 781-5040.
Bride’s side — Maha, (219) 765-9097.
